snippet.title: Hazard Levels - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
"Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and brew bizarre drinks to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders. 1.0 coming to Steam, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S on 12th November, crossplay enabled. 

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374680/Hazard_Levels?utm_source=hga-hot&utm_medium=yt&utm_campaign=releasedate"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
